name: [🎃Halloween] Untitled Battlegrounds
desc:
⚠️ Join Our Group for In-Game Rewards ⚠️

Untitled Battlegrounds is a fast-paced fighting game where you can play as characters from Forsaken and more. Battle other players, earn Tix, and unlock new characters. New content is added regularly. Like the game to stay updated.

🎮 Controls
G – Mode | F – Block | Q – Dash
Q (Ragdolled) – Evasive
Double-tap W – Sprint
Left Click – Attack | B – Emotes
